title: Rattle Tooth's Extended Kinfolk
description: Rattle Tooth's Extended Kinfolk — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Rattle Tooth's Aunt and Uncle then return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Rattle Tooth's Aunt and Uncle then return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Well, it looks like your value went back up. I can see the other Dungeon Runners eyeing you, calculating your net worth. I suggest you head back down to Algernon and take out a couple more members of the Rattle Family.

It looks like the next couple Family Members are assisting Sissirat's Squeakeasy business. I hear there is good money in that, but not nearly as good as taking you out. Head down into Algernon and find the next two Family Members.

Rattle Tooth's Uncle and Aunt, Rattle Tail and Rattle Elbow, have holed up in Not the Rumored Refinery. Once they're eliminated report back to me, the Townston Commander.

Turn-in:

I could not be happier that you're back. The Lieutenant didn't think you would return. Let's just say I played the odds and won a lot of money on that bet. Here's a little for you. This wouldn't have been possible without you!

Objectives:

  • Eliminate Rattle Tail
  • Eliminate Rattle Elbow

Client level range: 4–100
